svg.title: MSCA-Dilated weights and original feature path
svg.desc: Global average pooling and two pointwise convolutions yield the channel weights. The spatial gate uses the context projected from three independent 3 by 3 grouped convolution branches with dilation 1, 2 and 4. The sample grids mark the nine sampled positions in each receptive field. Spatial and channel weights are combined at the first product, and the second product applies them to the unmodified input F.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 5. Scientific source: MSCA_Dilated.py, Figure 5 label sheet and equations (2)–(6) of revision 44. Design reference: LoftUp, ICCV 2025, Fig. 3, for explicit spatial sample positions.
